title: ToolDeclaration
description: Cross-backend tool declaration. The side_effect_class vocabulary is adopted verbatim from the internal SideEffectClass enum (runtime/tool_side_effects.py): what a RETRY of this tool would do to external state. Failure layering: parameter-validation failures are rejected before dispatch (schema mismatch never reaches the business target); business rejection is a tool RESULT (a negative payload carried by a tool-result event - the run continues); system failure is a tool-level error event; remote outcome unknown reuses the outcome_unknown semantics and reconciles by idempotent id without blind retry.

input_schema_ref.description: URI of the tool's input JSON Schema; mismatches are rejected before dispatch.

output_schema_ref.description: URI of the tool's output JSON Schema; tool-result event payloads declare this reference.

side_effect_class.description: Retry semantics, adopted verbatim from the internal SideEffectClass enum.
